methods.v1: Blender heat weights on a welded authoring cage with anatomical bone axes. Restore distal thumb endpoint, then bake a 15-degree thumb opposition correction from the recorded Plate Launcher pose through inverse linear skinning. No pose driver is shipped.
methods.v2: Smooth native metacarpal/proximal/middle/distal weight transitions at the knuckles; vertex positions unchanged.
methods.v3: Blender heat weights on a welded authoring cage with anatomical bone axes. Blend over the palm/fingers beyond the wrist; preserve the existing thumb weights to avoid a Mini Cannon reload regression. Vertex positions unchanged.

invariants: Right arms, third-person meshes, UVs, triangles and bind poses unchanged
28 native bind poses and at most four weights per vertex
No runtime animation, IK, cloth, blend shape or bone additions
review: first-person-hands.blend contains editable native meshes and keyed weapon/inspection previews.
limitations: Existing v3 thumb/cuff crossing at Mini Cannon reload sample 120 remains: 39 triangle pairs before and after.
The lab material is unlit and does not reproduce the in-game contour shader. Blender clay renders were used to inspect surface folds.
